system.description:
You coat the body of a creature you touch in chakra and begin to imitate the color and texture of the area around them blending in like a chameleon. For the duration, they gain a Rank of Mastery to Stealth checks.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and you can target one additional creature for each rank and they gain the benefits of this jutsu as well. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank, increase the bonus granted to each creature to two Ranks of Mastery.
